transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

Let me go, I'll get you a new suit, and I'll be back in time. Please, just trust me on this.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Your parents? Harry, I know that's important, really, I do. But you've got to tell me these things! We live together! We're flatmates! I wouldn't have been pestering you about my robes if I knew you were caught up in something like that!
